notes.title: HAPPY NEW YEARS ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
[h2]Once again we hope everyone had a [b]Merry Christmas[/b] and we wish all of you a Happy and Healthy [b]New Year. [/b][/h2]

We would like to take this opportunity to [b]announce[/b] to all our Sinister Halloween Gamer's 
[h2]Our [b]brand new Multiplayer Co-op Game. Holy Purge.[/b][/h2]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844060/Holy_Purge/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33702081/a58ef36da55dea006fa530322e0f572f5a5853f0.gif[/img][/url]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33702081/2e27245b35364680d4ae9de2c9e8c65a5c8ac645.png[/img]
[h2]Make sure you [b]Add it to your Wish list![/b][/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1844060/Holy_Purge/

Our fans wanted a Co-op version of this game, So now, we are bringing it to you in 2022.
This game will be the extension of Sinister Halloween but focused on Multiplayer Co-op Experience.
Imagine Sinister Halloween's horror monsters packed into a multiplayer experience with your friends!

We will continue to support Sinister Halloween with Bug fixes and occasional DLC.
But we'd like to focus everyone's attention onto Holy Purge going into the future so we can bring horror games together with friends!



[h2]SINISTER HALLOWEEN JANUARY UPDATE INCOMING[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33702081/f69161406d9e94ba824b5d18dcbd532c637d581d.jpg[/img]

[*] Suggestions?
[/list]

notes.content:
Hello to our Sinister Halloween Fans!
[h1]STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33702081/7669c1c14ac5ede013eaa9109eaac8840d37b2e7.jpg[/img]
Achievements to accomplish are finally completed. This is our first time implementing achievements into a game and we did have difficulties, but we have overcome :)

[*] Cosmo Controllers Supported

Hopefully, we can get more of you Halloween fans to help us create the next terror for Halloween 2021. Head over to our Forum or Discord to let us know of your ideas. See you soon.

[h1]PLEASE REVIEW OUR GAME[/h1]
If you haven't done so, support us by making a review of the Game or Asylum DLC, we would really appreciate it. This will help us out and grow the Halloween Game Genre. Click links below to review.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33702081/d472e522a02bcf8af67cf5323df1ba1f88d2280d.jpg[/img]

We have been working hard to update our game to the latest version of Unreal 4.23.  This should allow window mixed reality headsets to work with the game.  Performance improvements for lower hardware. 

Now that we have completed everything promised in the early access for final version of SHVR.

We are now preparing to launch updates correctly with smaller patches and will

continue with bugs fixes, suggestions, and polish in the future.

We hope to work on some extra content this year.  [b]DLC [/b]content with additional maps.

3. Asylum Story Map

More info in the months to come. Prices have not been discussed yet, early development has started. you can follow us at our [url=https://twitter.com/HalloweenVRGame]TWITTER PAGE[/url] for updates.  With that said, let's prepare for another sinister Halloween this year with new content to immerse yourself into the spirit of Halloween, and keep it going through out the year ːsteamhappyː

Thank you for supporting our Halloween game.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33702081/18d486af4515eee9d6834b65e5331b5ca5f711a0.jpg[/img]

[u]SNAPTURN VR NOW SUPPORTED[/u]
SnapTurn is now available via off-hand (not the primary hand, which controls movement).

'Left' and 'Right' on the Oculus Thumbstick
OR
'Left' and 'Right' on the StreamVR TrackPad.

Finally, now players in VR are able to have a proper seated gameplay experience.


[u]PC GAME CONTROLLER NOW SUPPORTED[/u]
You can now use your XBox controller or PS4 controller (provided you install DS4)

Additionally, many bug fixes and polish have been made, to long of a list to point out.
(If you would like these list to be prepared and presented here in the news, 
let me know via the comments.)

notes.title: First Patch Update Coming Soon
notes.content:
Hello, Hope everyone is doing well.  We are announcing our [b]First update patch[/b] to be released in the coming days.

This patch focuses on addressing Public Feedback and Performance issues.

We have successfully increased performance by [b]200%[/b]

The Public feedback issues were posted in the forum discussion.

Unfortunately, we have not been able to update to the newest engine version due to problems that will take longer to solve.  We will continue to work on this in March.

Additionally, we have polished certain aspects of the game and added gameplay features to the town level.

We are working hard for our dream to come true.  We hope you guys continue to support us by spreading the news to everyone you know who enjoys Halloween and Horror games.
